components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Saffron pill for every WhatsApp action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.6rem; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 1rem/1.1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d4bd6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #f5b301; color: #10241c; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffc933; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Ink pill for search and form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.6rem; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 1rem/1.1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d4bd6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ink { background: #10241c; color: #f1f4ee; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #0d5c41; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.15rem; border: 2px solid #10241c; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #10241c; font: 700 .9375rem/1.1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #10241c; color: #f1f4ee; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d4bd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Property type filter; selected state fills ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 2px solid #10241c; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #10241c; font: 700 .9375rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(16,36,28,.08); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #10241c; color: #f1f4ee; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d4bd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Panel Field
components.description: Labeled select with a 2px ink border and 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-field { padding: 18px 20px; background: #f1f4ee; border-radius: 6px 36px 6px 6px; } .ds-field label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font: 700 .8125rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3b4f44; } .ds-field select { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid #10241c; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #10241c; font: 600 1rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d4bd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Jardim Green bar, white links with a saffron underline that scales in on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; background: #0d5c41; color: #fff; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; font: 700 1.5rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 10px 0; color: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 4px; height: 2px; background: #f5b301; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5b301; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Label Grid
components.description: Signature three-cell Código / Tipo / Bairro grid between ink rules, on every listing.
components.css: .ds-etiqueta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0,1fr); margin: 0; border-block: 1.5px solid #10241c; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #10241c; } .ds-etiqueta > div { padding: 9px 14px 9px 0; } .ds-etiqueta > div + div { padding-left: 14px; border-left: 1.5px solid #10241c; } .ds-etiqueta dt { margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #3b4f44; } .ds-etiqueta dd { margin: 0; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Arch and Corner Photo
components.description: Photo placeholder with one large quarter-circle corner and a saffron seal.
components.css: .ds-foto { position: relative; width: 240px; aspect-ratio: 4/5; background: #083d2b; border-radius: 132px 4px 4px 4px; overflow: hidden; transition: border-radius .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-foto:hover { border-top-left-radius: 200px; } .ds-selo { position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 14px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f5b301; color: #10241c; font: 700 .75rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: The Modernist House in Flat Colour
narrative.overview:
The site is one house drawn the way Brazilian modernism drew it: whole regions owned by a single saturated colour, arches standing on a concrete ground line, and a single quarter-circle swung out of an otherwise square photograph. Burle Marx colour fields, Niemeyer curves. Depth is stacking, never lighting: one flat shape overlaps another and that is the whole illusion.

Density is generous and mobile-first. Sections alternate whole colour fields (jardim green, cobalt, concrete, deep green) rather than sharing a neutral page with cards on it. The voice is direct and local, and the interface is built so that one saffron button, WhatsApp, is always the loudest thing within reach.
keyCharacteristics: Every section owns one flat colour field; no gradient, glass or blur anywhere in the build.
Arches (fully rounded top, square base) and a single large quarter-circle corner are the only large-scale shapes.
Every listing carries the same three-cell label grid (Código, Tipo, Bairro) between ink rules.
Saffron is spent on actions, the logo mark and one sun; nothing else.
Photos are placeholder stock, marked "Ilustrativo" on each card.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: A region is one solid colour. Depth comes from overlapping shapes and adjacent fields, never from shadow, gradient, glass or blur.

rules.name: The Saffron Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Saffron marks the action, the mark and the sun. It is never a background for a whole section and never decoration for its own sake.

rules.name: The Paired Text Rule
rules.body: Light fields take Ink and Ink Soft; green fields take white and Menta; cobalt takes white and Azul Claro. Do not cross the pairs.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, chips and buttons are sentence case at normal tracking. Small caps-style uppercase labels are not part of this system.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Bricolage headings run -0.02em to -0.035em tracking and balanced wrapping; body text never does.

rules.name: The Layered Colour Rule
rules.body: To raise something, put a different flat colour behind or in front of it. Never add a shadow.

dos: Do give each section a whole flat colour field and keep text on its paired colour set.
Do cut photos with exactly one large quarter-circle corner (or a full arch) and 4px on the rest.
Do keep the saffron pill as the single dominant action on any screen.
Do rule every listing with the same Código / Tipo / Bairro label grid.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more and set focus rings by field colour.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass or blur; layer flat colour instead.
Don't use saffron as a section background or for ornament.
Don't round every corner of a photo; one big curve per piece.
Don't fall back to the real-estate default of navy and gold with a stock hero photo and a bolted-on search bar.
Don't set uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings; the build has none.
